repos.label: shell
repos.shape: a GNOME Shell extension in TypeScript (window tiling): GJS imports, signal callbacks and GObject classes, no network boundary

repos.label: websocket
repos.shape: a Go protocol library (gorilla/websocket): client and server halves of one protocol in one package, exported API used only by examples and tests

repos.label: samples
repos.shape: a monorepo of ~50 Flutter sample apps; compass_app pairs a Dart shelf server with a Flutter client over HTTP / JSON models

repos.label: commons-text
repos.shape: a Java utility library (Apache Commons Text): deep class hierarchies, overload-heavy public API, no boundary

repos.label: microservices-demo
repos.shape: eleven services in five languages (Go, C#, Node, Python, Java) joined by gRPC from one protos/ dir, a Go web frontend and a Python load generator

repos.label: click
repos.shape: a Python CLI library (pallets/click): decorators building commands, a src/ layout, no boundary

repos.label: immich
repos.shape: a NestJS server (enum-member controller prefixes), an OpenAPI-generated fetch SDK as a pnpm workspace package, a SvelteKit web app (.svelte) and a Flutter mobile app, a Python ML service

repos.label: twenty
repos.shape: a large Nx TypeScript monorepo: a NestJS server exposing GraphQL and REST, a React front end through Apollo hooks and generated GraphQL types, shared workspace packages

repos.label: photoprism
repos.shape: a Go (gin) API with route groups and swaggo annotations, and a Vue 3 front end with hand-written REST model classes

repos.label: gin-vue-admin
repos.shape: a Go (gin) admin backend with router-group registration per module and a Vue 3 admin front end calling it through a `service({ url, method })` wrapper

repos.label: scaffold-eth-2
repos.shape: a Solidity (Hardhat) dapp starter with a Next.js client that reads contracts through wagmi hooks and a generated deployedContracts.ts, no HTTP

repos.label: documenso
repos.shape: tRPC: a document-signing app whose React Router (formerly Next.js) client calls a tRPC router in a workspace package, typed end to end with no URL strings, plus a ts-rest public API

repos.label: medusa
repos.shape: Zod + Express: a commerce engine whose Express-based API routes validate with Zod schemas (validators.ts), called by a React admin dashboard through a hand-written JS SDK workspace package

repos.label: mealie
repos.shape: Pydantic / FastAPI + TS client: a recipe manager with a FastAPI backend of Pydantic schemas and a Nuxt (Vue) client whose API classes wrap route strings and whose types are generated from the Pydantic models

repos.label: hoppscotch
repos.shape: GraphQL codegen: an API client app whose NestJS backend is code-first GraphQL and whose Vue front ends issue .graphql documents compiled by graphql-codegen (urql)

repos.label: tolgee
repos.shape: Kotlin + Spring: a localization platform with a Kotlin Spring Boot backend (annotated controllers, JPA) and a React web app typed by an openapi-typescript generated schema

repos.label: prefect
repos.shape: a Python monorepo: one src/ tree holding a FastAPI server, its Python client, 19 integration packages under src/integrations/, and two Vue / React UIs (ui-v2 typed by generated OpenAPI types)

repos.label: zora-protocol
repos.shape: a Solidity protocol with its clients: Foundry contract packages, wagmi-generated ABI packages, and the TypeScript SDK and CLI that call the contracts through viem

repos.label: chatwoot
repos.shape: Rails + JS: a support desk with Rails controllers, jbuilder views and an enterprise overlay, and Vue dashboards / widget calling it through ApiClient subclasses that build URLs from a resource name

repos.label: squidex
repos.shape: .NET + TS: a headless CMS with an ASP.NET Core backend (attribute-routed controllers, DTO classes) and an Angular front end with hand-written services and a generated model file

repos.label: plane
repos.shape: Django REST + Next.js: a project tracker whose Django REST Framework API (serializers, viewsets, url patterns) is called by several Next.js apps through TS service classes in a workspace package
